name: ScratchTorso_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its right hand to briefly scratch its lower torso and look down, then returns to its neutral posture.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its right hand up towards its lower chest/torso area. Simultaneously, it tilts its head slightly downward and to the right, looking at its own hand. After making a brief scratching or touching motion against its torso with its right fingers, it lowers its arm and returns its head to a forward-facing, upright neutral position.
